eyebrow: Spin up, migrate, test, tear down
code:
- name: Spin up test database
  run: sqlcmd -Q "CREATE DATABASE PipelineTestDb"

- name: Apply migrations
  run: ./run-migrations.ps1 -Database PipelineTestDb

- name: Run smoke tests
  run: ./smoke-tests.ps1 -Database PipelineTestDb

- name: Tear down test database
  run: sqlcmd -Q "DROP DATABASE PipelineTestDb"
caption: A fresh, disposable database proves migrations work from a clean slate.
Small, fast sanity checks — not exhaustive testing.
